name: AJI
recent: Ajinomoto (Malaysia) 在 2026 年 9 月 24 日的股东特别大会（EGM）上通过了由母公司提出的选择性资本削减与偿还（SCR）私有化议案，随后在 2026 年 8 月 26 日向股东发出相关通函。公司也在同一天举行了第 65 届年度股东大会，所有决议均获通过。此外，公司在 2026 年 8 月 28 日宣布更换公司秘书。
notable: 股东在 2026 年 9 月 24 日的 EGM 上通过了由母公司提出的选择性资本削减与偿还（SCR）私有化议案。
公司于 2026 年 8 月 26 日向股东发出有关私有化议案的通函，并附上 RHB Investment Bank 的独立意见。
公司于 2026 年 8 月 28 日宣布更换公司秘书，Yee Kit Yeng 和 Winnie Goh Kah Mun 卸任。

news.title: Simak Rekomendasi Teknikal Saham BBCA, UNTR dan AKRA untuk Kamis (19/11)
Ajinomoto Malaysia shareholders approve parent’s RM20 privatisation offer

recent_en: Ajinomoto (Malaysia) passed the proposed selective capital reduction and repayment (SCR) privatisation by its parent at an EGM on 24 September 2026, after issuing a circular to shareholders on 26 August 2026. The company also held its 65th AGM on the same day, with all resolutions approved. Separately, it announced a change of company secretary on 28 August 2026.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the proposed selective capital reduction and repayment (SCR) privatisation by the parent at the EGM on 24 September 2026.
The company issued a circular to shareholders on 26 August 2026 regarding the privatisation proposal, including the independent advice letter from RHB Investment Bank.
The company announced a change of company secretary on 28 August 2026, with Yee Kit Yeng and Winnie Goh Kah Mun ceasing to act.
